ety.scriptHosts.markdownDescription: File extensions whose `<script>` blocks ety analyzes. `.html` works by default; add server-side template formats like `jsp`, `aspx`, `tpl`, `ftl` to enable type-checking of their `<script>` JavaScript. **Reload the window after changing** (the document selector is fixed per session).

ety.autoAnnotate.markdownDescription: Offer a Quick Fix (lightbulb) to insert the inferred `// T:` type comment on an un-annotated `let`/`const`/`var` declaration, e.g. `Insert // T: number` on `let i = 0;`. Only offered for the same closed set of types completion already suggests inside `// T:`. Set to `false` to turn this suggestion off.
